input_fields.name: parameter_declaration
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `name`, `value`, `unit`, `allowed_range`, and `provenance`; it is the single parameter being checked.

input_fields.name: single_constraint
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `operator`, `operand`, and `unit`; optional key `inclusive` preserves bound semantics for this single constraint.

result_fields.name: constraint_result
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `parameter_name`, `value`, `operator`, `operand`, `unit`, `verdict`, and `violation_reason`; nullable when the common output envelope records missing comparison data.

procedure: Verify that exactly one parameter and one constraint are present and that their dimensions and units are comparable.
Normalize the constraint without changing its operator, bounds, or inclusivity, then compare it with the supplied parameter value.
Record the normalized constraint, value, units, pass or fail outcome, and a concrete violation reason when applicable.
Return `constraint_result` as action data and place status, provenance ownership, and any unresolved fields in the common output envelope.
rejection_rules: Reject a multi-parameter or compound constraint; split it into independently checked constraints.
Reject missing values, incompatible units, invalid bound ordering, or an unknown comparison operator.
Do not mutate the parameter declaration or convert an unknown value into a passing result.
